text:
Priya (CS): Acme says after the east-region release yesterday ~10% of generated payloads are missing the required "order_id" field (they get null or the key is absent). They parse with a strict JSON schema and this is breaking ingestion. Sample response attached.

Acme Integrations: Repro steps:
1) POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate model=redwood-prod-20260315
2) prompt = order-fulfillment template V3
They provided failing response and request id: req_8f7a3b21.

Acme Integrations: ```
{
  "customer": "ACME Corp",
  "order_id": null,
  "items": [
    {"sku": "WID-100", "qty": 2}
  ],
  "meta": {"source": "nlp-generator"}
}
```

Priya (CS): @Luca can you triage? They say it only started after the us-east deploy. :eyes:

Luca (Platform): Looking. Can you confirm region? Deploy logs show the us-east kernel/normalizer flip yesterday.

Acme Integrations: Confirmed - issue only on us-east responses. All other regions OK.

Luca (Platform): We rolled v2.8.3 in us-east which enabled the new "compact-normalizer" for long outputs to reduce token count. Hypothesis: normalizer may drop keys when values are empty/whitespace. Pulling logs for req_8f7a3b21.

Samir (SRE): Are these returning 200 with bad JSON or 500?

Acme Integrations: 200 OK. Payloads are syntactically valid JSON but violate their schema (missing/nullable required keys).

Luca (Platform): Got the payload for req_8f7a3b21, same as their snippet. Looks like the normalizer post-process removed non-printing characters and then pruned keys with falsy string values. For some prompts, the model emits a single zero-width space instead of an actual id and the normalizer treats that as empty and drops the key.

Luca (Platform): deploy-bot: "deploy v2.8.3 -> us-east by luca at 2026-03-15T02:13Z"

Priya (CS): Customer impact: 3 downstream jobs blocked in their pipeline. They want either a rollback or per-customer routing to previous normalizer.

Luca (Platform): Quick mitigation: I can add a routing rule to pin ACME to the stable normalizer variant (v2.8.2 behavior) for us-east while we patch. Will do a 10m change.

Samir (SRE): I'll create synthetic checks to assert presence of required keys (order_id) for our canaries and raise an alert if >1% missing. Will also watch error budget.

Luca (Platform): For the long-term fix: update compact-normalizer to treat zero-width and whitespace-only strings as non-empty for required-key detection, or ensure we emit explicit null instead of dropping key. I'll open PR and a rollout plan.

Priya (CS): Thanks. I'll confirm with Acme that pinning to stable behavior solves their immediate issue and ask for a timeline for a permanent fix.

Acme Integrations: Thank you, appreciate the quick response. Please keep us posted on ETA.

Priya (CS): Filing a follow-up ticket for postmortem and customer communication.

Luca (Platform): Notes for follow-up: reproduce locally with prompt set V3 + long item lists, unit test for compact-normalizer, add per-customer routing telemetry.

Samir (SRE): Setting an alert: channel #incidents if >1% schema violations across production in any region.

Priya (CS): Will update thread when ACME confirms ingest resumed.
